proof:
Notation: ℝ^{n+ℓ} = Amb n ℓ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+ℓ)); H^n = μHE[n] is Mathlib's Euclidean Hausdorff measure on ℝ^{n+ℓ}; for c ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ} and R > 0, ψ(x) := c + R x and φ(y) := R⁻¹(y − c); κ := (ENNReal.ofReal (R^n))⁻¹, i.e. R^{-n} as an element of [0, ∞]. This is step 4 of the parent proof.
1. The constant. κ ≠ 0, because ENNReal.ofReal (R^n) ≠ ∞ (ENNReal.inv_ne_zero).
2. The homeomorphism. Let e be the homeomorphism x ↦ c + R x of ℝ^{n+ℓ} (Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero R, R ≠ 0, followed by Homeomorph.addLeft c); e = ψ pointwise. Since e(φ(y)) = c + R R⁻¹ (y − c) = y, injectivity gives e⁻¹(y) = φ(y) for all y. Thus φ is a homeomorphism, ψ(φ(y)) = y and φ(ψ(x)) = x, and φ = e⁻¹ is a measurable embedding (Homeomorph.measurableEmbedding). Hence (Measure.map φ μ_V)(G) = μ_V(φ⁻¹(G)) for EVERY set G (MeasurableEmbedding.map_apply), and μ_W(G) = κ · μ_V(φ⁻¹(G)) (Measure.smul_apply).
3. Support criterion (Measure.mem_support_iff_forall): z ∈ spt ν ⟺ ν(G) > 0 for every neighbourhood G of z.
4. Claim: for every x, x ∈ spt μ_W ⟺ ψ(x) ∈ spt μ_V.
(⇒) Let G be a neighbourhood of ψ(x). Since ψ is continuous at x, ψ⁻¹(G) is a neighbourhood of x (ContinuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds), so 0 < μ_W(ψ⁻¹(G)) = κ · μ_V(φ⁻¹(ψ⁻¹(G))) = κ · μ_V(G), because φ⁻¹(ψ⁻¹(G)) = (ψ ∘ φ)⁻¹(G) = G. A product in [0, ∞] is positive only if both factors are (ENNReal.mul_pos_iff), so μ_V(G) > 0. Hence ψ(x) ∈ spt μ_V.
(⇐) Let G be a neighbourhood of x. Since φ is continuous at ψ(x) and φ(ψ(x)) = x, φ⁻¹(G) is a neighbourhood of ψ(x), so μ_V(φ⁻¹(G)) > 0. Then μ_W(G) = κ · μ_V(φ⁻¹(G)) > 0 because both factors are nonzero (ENNReal.mul_pos). Hence x ∈ spt μ_W.
5. Consequently spt μ_W = ψ⁻¹(spt μ_V). Therefore spt W = ψ⁻¹(U) ∩ spt μ_W = ψ⁻¹(U) ∩ ψ⁻¹(spt μ_V) = ψ⁻¹(U ∩ spt μ_V) = ψ⁻¹(spt V) (preimage_inter). Multiplying by the positive finite constant κ does not change the support, as step 4 shows directly.
